card.headline: pafos hit back for a *first point*.

highlight.text: Biel equalised, nine minutes after Caio Ferreira put Riga ahead.

card.footnote:
Matchday 1: Atalanta 3-1 Pafos FC.
Next: Twente v Pafos FC, Thursday 5 November.

caption:
Pafos FC came from behind to draw 1-1 with Riga FC in the Conference League. ⚽

Caio Ferreira put Riga ahead on 67 minutes, and Biel equalised on 76.

It's Pafos's first point of the league phase, after a 3-1 defeat at Atalanta on matchday 1. Next up: Twente away on Thursday 5 November.

Fair result? 🇨🇾

Source: UEFA
